pop.name: INE — Cifras oficiales de población de los municipios (padrón), table 2871
pop.method: residents on 1 January each year (1997 not published)

pyr.name: INE — Estadística del Padrón Continuo, table 33570 (sex × 5-year age group)
pyr.method: residents on 1 January; the latest year INE publishes by municipality and age

foreign.name: INE — Padrón Continuo, table 33571 (nationality)
foreign.method: residents with a foreign nationality ÷ all residents

demo.name: INE — Atlas de distribución de renta de los hogares (ADRH), demographic indicators, table 31033
demo.method: tax-register based; mean age, shares under 18 and 65+, mean household size, one-person households

incsrc.name: INE — ADRH, income by source, table 31026
incsrc.method: share of gross income from each source

vut.name: INE — Viviendas turísticas en España (experimental statistics), tables 39363 / 39366
vut.method: listings on Airbnb, Booking and Vrbo matched to the census of dwellings; experimental statistics

jobs.name: INE — Censo de Población (annual), table 69992: employed residents by activity
jobs.method: where the residents work by sector (place of residence, not of work)

act.name: INE — Censo de Población (annual), table 67078: relation to activity
act.method: unemployed ÷ (employed + unemployed), residents 16 and over (census definition, not the EPA rate, not SEPE registrations)

outline.name: IGN — WFS unidades administrativas (au:AdministrativeUnit)
outline.method: official municipal limits, simplified to 5 m for display

sp_outline.name: IGN outlines × repository layers
sp_outline.method: areas measured in EPSG:25830 inside the official outline

ghs.name: JRC GHSL — GHS-POP R2023A, 2020, 100 m
ghs.method: modelled residents per 100 m cell, summed by cell centre inside the outline

lst.name: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 surface temperature (ST_B10), June–August 2024–2026, 30 clear scenes
lst.method: median of the summer-median 90 m cells whose centre is inside the outline (≥ 60 % of the municipality inside the frame)

wc.name: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, 10 m, class 10 tree cover
wc.method: tree cells ÷ cells with data inside the outline (sampled every 30 m)

lu.name: OpenStreetMap landuse (supplied extract, 23 Oct 2026)
lu.method: mapped land-use polygons intersected with the outline; unmapped land is not counted

reach.name: GHS-POP 2020 × OpenStreetMap schools / health facilities
reach.method: share of modelled residents within 500 m straight-line distance of a mapped facility — a spatial measure of proximity, not observed behaviour

bus.name: Bus stops and weekday trips (city file + CTAN consortium, Monday 26 Oct 2026)
bus.method: scheduled trips per day summed over the stops inside the outline (a trip is counted at every stop it serves)

periods.name: OSM footprints + Catastro year of construction (INSPIRE Buildings, 2026)
periods.method: buildings counted per 100 m cell by construction period; buildings without a year are shown as unknown

floors.name: OpenStreetMap building:levels
floors.method: median floor count per 100 m cell; most footprints in the five towns have no floor count — those cells stay unknown

rain.name: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo, cell 37.25 N 3.5 W
rain.method: mean monthly precipitation over 30 years (a 0.25° reanalysis cell, not a rain gauge)

wind.name: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo, hourly 10 m wind
wind.method: share of hours by direction the wind blows from (8 sectors); calm = below 1 m/s

temp.name: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo, daily 2 m temperature at the base
temp.method: monthly means of the daily maximum, mean and minimum; hot days = daily maximum ≥ 35 °C; tropical nights = minimum ≥ 20 °C. A 0.25° reanalysis cell: regional, not street-level

cmip6.name: CMIP6 HighResMIP (7 models) via Open-Meteo Climate API — daily maximum temperature at the base
cmip6.method: annual mean of the daily maximum per model, high-emission forcing (HighResMIP, SSP5-8.5 after 2015); the band is the spread of the models. No downscaled series to 2076 was available to the atlas

air.name: CAMS European air-quality model via Open-Meteo (PM2.5, PM10, NO2)
air.method: monthly mean of hourly model values at the base and at the city centre — a model on a ~10 km grid, NOT a measurement; no official monitoring station stands in the five towns

sepe.name: SEPE — Paro registrado por municipios (open data, first half of 2026)
sepe.method: people registered as job seekers without work at the public employment service at the end of each month — registrations, not an unemployment rate

rd1989.name: Real Decreto 511/1989, de 28 de abril — servidumbres aeronáuticas del Aeródromo Militar de Armilla (BOE 13 May 1989, pp. 14325–14326)
rd1989.method: reference point, runway 18-36 thresholds and helicopter area transcribed from the annex (geographic coordinates)

flood.name: MITECO — Sistema Nacional de Cartografía de Zonas Inundables (SNCZI), WFS gis.miteco.gob.es/geoserver/agua
flood.method: modelled flood extents for return periods of 10, 100 and 500 years, the preferential-flow zone and ARPSI reaches; buildings counted by footprint centre inside each extent (OSM, simplified)

rd1989.note: The easement surfaces themselves follow Decreto 584/1972 (replaced by RD 369/2023 from 1 July 2023); their plans were sent to the town halls and are not published — the atlas does not draw them.
